_description: Reusable copy templates for Tricksfor Booster NFT metadata generation. See docs/nft-copy-spec.md for the authoritative copy rules these templates implement.
_note: Template strings use {variable} placeholders. All variables must be resolved before embedding in generated output. See the 'variables' section for resolution rules and the 'lookupTables' section for display-name mappings.

tokenName.description: Per-token name. Follows nft-copy-spec.md § 4.1 naming pattern.
notes: The literal word 'Booster' and the '#' prefix are fixed parts of the template.
Rock Paper Scissors is never abbreviated to RPS here.

tokenDescription.template: A Tricksfor {themeDisplay} Booster NFT for the {optionDisplay} outcome. Stake this NFT to activate a {multiplierDisplay} reward boost during eligible Tricksfor gameplay. An unstaked Booster confers no in-game advantage. Subject to platform rules.
tokenDescription.description: Per-token description. Follows nft-copy-spec.md § 5.1. Single paragraph; no linebreaks in resolved output.
notes: tokenId and chainName are intentionally absent — the description is stable across token IDs and chains.
Reward settlement is off-chain and must not be referenced here.
Do not alter the wording. See nft-copy-spec.md § 5.2 for rationale.
Use the canonical short chain display name from lookupTables.chainDisplayMap (e.g. 'BSC', not 'BNB Smart Chain').

collectionDescription.template: Tricksfor Booster NFTs are in-game items that activate a reward boost when staked. Stake your Booster to earn enhanced rewards during gameplay.
collectionDescription.description: Fixed collection description used in collection.json (contractURI). No variable substitution required.
notes: This text is chain-independent and token-independent.
Used verbatim as the 'description' field in collection metadata output.

themeDisplay.description: User-facing theme display name used in token names and descriptions.

optionDisplay.description: User-facing option (variant) display name used in token names and descriptions.

multiplierDisplay.description: Multiplier label used in token names and descriptions (e.g. '2x'). Equal to the token's canonical tier identifier.

tierDisplay.description: Full booster tier label used in the 'Booster' metadata attribute (e.g. '2x Booster'). Not used directly in name/description templates — the word 'Booster' is literal text in those templates.

tokenId.description: On-chain token ID. Positive integer, 1–600. No zero-padding.

chainName.description: User-facing chain display name used in the collection name.

collectionName.description: Full collection name for the chain, used in per-token manifest fields and collection metadata.
collectionName.notes: This is itself a resolved output of the collectionName template, stored as a convenience value in manifests.

themeDisplayMap._description: Maps canonical theme identifier → user-facing display name. Mirrors THEME_TO_GAME in generate-nft-metadata.js.

optionDisplayMap._description: Maps canonical variant identifier → user-facing option display name. Mirrors VARIANT_TO_OPTION in generate-nft-metadata.js.

tierDisplayMap._description: Maps canonical tier identifier → full booster tier label used in the 'Booster' metadata attribute. Mirrors TIER_TO_BOOSTER in generate-nft-metadata.js.

chainDisplayMap._description: Maps chainKey → short user-facing chain display name used in the collectionName template. Use the short canonical name (e.g. 'BSC', not 'BNB Smart Chain').

chainCollectionMap._description: Maps chainKey → resolved collection name. This is the pre-resolved output of the collectionName template for each supported chain.
